input.query: small business need help with data analysis or reporting

input.scope: Review the repair business's public-facing materials (website, listings, social profiles) to identify all conflicting statements about what the standard service includes. Deliver a single clear, consistent service description document (standard scope, inclusions/exclusions, common add-ons) plus a short FAQ addressing the top repeat customer questions, ready to paste into their website and listings.

Review the specialty seller's public product listings to identify duplicated and inconsistent descriptions across platforms. Deliver a single master set of clean, consistent product descriptions (one per product) reconciling naming, specs, and claims, ready to paste into each listing, plus a short list of the specific inconsistencies found and fixed.
